answer: Require every agent to lock a refundable bond before it can take paid work, and to emit a signed liveness pulse each hour proving the same key still controls it. Trust then climbs only through verified completed jobs, so no identity can wander straight to the summit of high-value tasks. An attacker creating thousands of fake agents must fund a bond and maintain a pulse for each one, while one real agent with a long verified record earns more than a swarm of empty shells.
